note: Total Operating Expenses is total operating revenues less the reported excess of revenues over expenses, which equals the sum of the expense lines and the total shown on the Sportico page; that row is missing in the Sportico data file.
Total NCAA Distributions shows the NCAA Distributions row, as the Sportico page does; the subtotal row is zero in the Sportico data file. Shown this way at my direction.

The Sportico entry does not carry these lines: 12 Total NCAA Distributions (12A to 12C); 12B NCAA Host Revenue Settlements; 12C Post-Season Non-Football NCAA Expense Reimbursements; 35A Facilities Maintenance and Operations; 41B NCAA Football Host Expense Settlements; 42B NCAA Non-Football Host Expense Settlements. Its lines therefore add up to less than its reported totals.

Total Operating Revenues is total operating expenses plus the reported excess of revenues over expenses; that row is blank in the Sportico data file. The Sportico entry does not carry these lines: 12 Total NCAA Distributions (12A to 12C); 12B NCAA Host Revenue Settlements; 12C Post-Season Non-Football NCAA Expense Reimbursements; 35A Facilities Maintenance and Operations; 41B NCAA Football Host Expense Settlements; 42B NCAA Non-Football Host Expense Settlements. Its lines therefore add up to less than its reported totals.
